replica.title: TTSVoiceReplica
replica.description:
Voice clone settings. Gemini 3.8 only. Optional. Mutually exclusive with `voice_name` — do not send both on the same speaker.

When set, this task temporarily clones the speaker from two recordings. The clone is not saved as a reusable voice. You can pass `replica` for a speaker in both single-speaker and two-speaker requests.

Both recordings must be of the same adult, captured with the same microphone in the same room. AI-generated audio is rejected.

WAV only. Recommended: 24kHz, mono, 16-bit PCM. Max 10MB per file. Format is detected from file content, not the extension or Content-Type.

source_audio_url.description: URL of the reference recording. The file must be directly downloadable. Record 10–30 seconds of natural speech in a quiet space: no echo, no background music, and only one voice. Record in the language you will generate.

consent_audio_url.description:
URL of the consent recording. The file must be directly downloadable. The same person as in the reference recording must read this sentence verbatim:

I am the owner of this voice and I consent to Google using this voice to create a synthetic voice model.

Other supported language versions of this sentence are also accepted. Trim silence and noise at the start and end.

filler_words.description: Whether to insert filler words in two-speaker dialogue. Off by default (omit this field); when enabled, the request includes `"filler_words": true`. Only takes effect when `speakers` has two speakers (e.g. Speaker 1 and Speaker 2). When two people are speaking, you can turn on this switch.

dialogue_turns.description: List of dialogue turns, output in sequential order

text.description:
The speaker's line. May include tone tags wrapped in English angle brackets. Example: Hello there. `<laugh>` That works.

Official insertable tags: `<argh>`, `<breath>`, `<cackle>`, `<cheer>`, `<chuckle>`, `<chuckles>`, `<cough>`, `<cry>`, `<exhales>`, `<gasp>`, `<giggle>`, `<groan>`, `<growl>`, `<grr>`, `<grunt>`, `<heavy breath>`, `<hiss>`, `<laugh>`, `<laughter>`, `<long pause>`, `<moan>`, `<pant>`, `<pff>`, `<phew>`, `<scream>`, `<short pause>`, `<shout>`, `<shriek>`, `<sigh>`, `<sighs>`, `<sneeze>`, `<snicker>`, `<snort>`, `<sob>`, `<throat-clearing>`, `<tsk>`, `<whimper>`, `<whispering>`, `<whispers>`, `<yawn>`.

style.description: Per-turn speaking style, 3.8 only. Freely describe tone, emotion, and pace; different lines from the same speaker can differ. Example: Speak like a tired night-shift radio host, slow and dry.
